main_text.p: liquiis[?] supponebantur passim falsæ: vt Apostolorum Martyrumque loco, sicariorum forsan & meretricum ossa nonnunquam etiam pecudum, imo & viliora qua pecudum colerentur. a Auguft.de oper. monachor. cap. 28. Genus impofturæ, quod Auguftinus & Gregorius suis temporibus pullulasse indicant: {a}ille, circumforaneos quosdam hypocritas membra martyrum, si tamen martyrum venditare conquerens: {b}hic affirmans Græcos monachos deprehensos, qui corpora mortuorum in Romano quodam campo iacentia effodientes, & recondentes ossa, confessi sint se illa tanquam Sanctorum reliquias in Græciam portaturos. Sed ita mirabiliter crevit sub Papatu, vt {c}Divus Petrus (exempli gratia) reconditus integer uno loco, {d}dimidiatus haberetur alio, & nescio quota parte {e}tertio; in {f}quarto, caput eius asservaretur; in {g}quinto, pars capitis; in {h}sexto, mandibula cum barba; in septimo, vel in {i}septem potius locis, dentes, alibi plures, alibi singuli; {k}cerebrum (id erat pumex) in octavo; adde {l}ossa multa, {m}partem lacerti, {n}partem costæ, {o}digitum manus, {p}digitum pedis, {q}articulum digiti gigantei, præter {r}reliquias absque nomine. Ac, ne Petro soli hoc accidisse putemus, {s}multi, Gigantis ryonis instar, facti sunt tricorpores. Immo {t}Diui Barbaræ caput tot locis ostendebatur, vt eam

page.notes: Right margin notes are placed at approximate positions beside their lines; some marginal letters are uncertain (c/e and f/g in the margin are hard to separate from the text marks). Underlines, strokes and handwritten marks along the right edge and through the first lines are not printed text and are omitted. Several text marks and the note letters for "{s}" and "{t}" are doubtful. The "s" forms have been read as plain s throughout. Words "liquiis", "retricum" and "ryonis" are uncertain. The bottom block is an overflow of the right margin notes and footnotes; the individual footnote letters below are as read and some may be misread.
